systems.name: EZLynx
systems.notes: Central hub — all data converges here. Single-user license; additional user = $150/month. Has REST API (JSON/XML, webhooks). Postman docs available. Currently detached from email flow — requires manual data entry.

systems.name: Wonder Write
systems.notes: Digitizes ACORD forms (125, 126, 140). Pulls basic contact info from EZLynx. $140/month. Replaces manual DocuSign field placement for commercial lines.

systems.name: Microsoft Outlook
systems.notes: Primary communication hub. Outlook plugin allows manual email-to-EZLynx file saves. Currently used as task manager via pinned emails — major bottleneck. Zapier integration attempted but not working.

systems.name: WordPress + Gravity Forms
systems.notes: Primary lead capture. Zapier bridge to EZLynx is broken — all lead data is manually re-entered into EZLynx.

systems.name: Zapier
systems.notes: Attempted to bridge WordPress/Outlook → EZLynx. Not working. Needs rebuild or replacement.

systems.name: DocuSign
systems.notes: Used for client onboarding documents. Still requires manual field placement even with templates. Wonder Write partially replaces for commercial ACORD forms.

systems.name: LightSpeed Voice / Orbit
systems.notes: Pulls up client EZLynx file on incoming calls. Call recording available. No automated transcription/summarization yet — manual note-taking into EZLynx required.

carriers: Mix of direct (e.g., Liberty Mutual for standard lines) + surplus/alliance market via wholesalers
